statement: A refresh token (the claim cosec.token, which the converter writes as refresh) is invalid wherever an access token is expected, on every path that verifies one: signed and unexpired, it never authenticates as a principal, so a principal named after the access token's id cannot exist. A token without the claim is an access token, whoever issued it. The other way too: a refresh reads only a refresh token where one belongs, issued with the access token it is presented with (its sub is that token's jti, its iat that token's iat); an access token there is refused, so whoever holds a token of a principal named after another token's id cannot refresh that token.
